answer: Because the cipher decay curve is applied at close, the marble weight of every idle key falls, and the willow history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 37% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny hence loses 129 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 38 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
